title: PREMARKET LIVE: The Trading Floor | Stocks to Watch and Key Levels

Software names expected to be hurt by AI (CRM, Workday) are setting up well after Gartner's AI revenue comments.
Market may be rotating back toward slow, steady cash-flow companies.
